title: Data and code for: The hidden links between animal weapons, fighting style, and their effect on contest success - a meta-analysis
description:
Data and code for a phylogenetic meta-analysis of how animal weapons influence contest success, and for the individual-based simulation that underpins its effect-size rationale. Contains 173 effect sizes from 49 studies and 52 species, the shared-control correlation matrices used in the multilevel models, the metafor analysis script, the forest-plot code and the simulation model.

Supplement to: The hidden links between animal weapons, fighting style, and their effect on contest success: a meta-analysis. Biological Reviews 97(5): 1948–1966. doi:10.1111/brv.12877
